subject.title: Token-gated dashboard snapshots for codexbar serve (restart of #1026)

question: Should CodexBar ship non-loopback plain-HTTP serving when it requires both a bearer token and explicit `--allow-plain-http` acceptance?
rationale: The implementation can enforce and document this boundary, but only repository ownership can accept the product-level risk of reusable credentials traversing trusted networks without encryption.

options.title: Accept trusted-network mode
options.body: Keep non-loopback serving behind a token plus `--allow-plain-http`, with TLS termination recommended for broader deployments.

options.title: Keep loopback-only
options.body: Remove remote binding and ship only the local token-gated snapshot endpoint.

options.title: Require encrypted transport
options.body: Pause remote serving until CodexBar directly provides TLS or can enforce a verifiable TLS-termination contract.

recommendation.title: Accept trusted-network mode
recommendation.body: Keep non-loopback serving behind a token plus `--allow-plain-http`, with TLS termination recommended for broader deployments.
